title: Eleven Years of It, Never Told
subtitle: 青春成长 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 青春成长（生活与学习·青春与成长）
meta: 主题语境：青春成长（生活与学习·青春与成长）　|　核心词汇：youth　|　正文 311 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 youth 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandmother's ① youth ended at eleven, by which she meant she went into service, and she never once spoke of it as a loss, which I think is the thing I have found hardest to forgive. ② In her youth, as she told it, there were eleven children in two rooms and a mother who sang, which she said made up for everything and which I do not believe.

In 1931 a ③ youth from the next village came to the door asking for work and stayed eleven years, and my grandmother said he was the only person her father ever liked. The ④ youth, meaning the young as a class, were blamed for everything then, as they are now, and she said the blaming is the one thing that never has to be learned.

There was ⑤ youth in her still at sixty-one, by which my father meant she laughed, and she said laughter is not youth but only what is left when everything else has been taken, and youth, she said, is not a time but a debt.

The ⑥ youth of the village, meaning the eleven or twelve who were left by 1940, went in 1940, and three of them did not come back, and she said she had not known any of their names. In 1961 she helped at the ⑦ youth club on Fridays — eleven children and one piano — and she said there was ⑧ a youth of seventeen there who reminded her of somebody she would not name.

The ⑨ youth she had, and it was eleven years of it, is the part of the story she never told, and I have stopped asking. The ⑩ youth I had, and I had a long one, lasted until I was thirty-one, and she said once that I had spent it on nothing, and no youth, she said, is ever wasted on the young.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 青春；青年时期
B. n. 年轻人；小伙子（a youth）
C. n. （总称）青年人；年轻人这个群体（the youth）
D. n. 年轻；朝气；青春气
E. 固定搭配：in one's youth 在某人年轻的时候
F. 固定搭配：the youth of ... ……的青年们
G. 固定搭配：youth club 青年俱乐部
H. 固定搭配：a youth of ... 一个……岁的年轻人

answers.why: youth 意为“青春、青年时期”，祖母的青春在十一岁结束，意思是她去帮佣了。
in her youth 意为“在她年轻的时候”，据她说，她年轻时两间屋子里住着十一个孩子。
a youth 意为“一个年轻人、小伙子”，1931 年邻村的一个年轻人上门讨活干，一干就是十一年。
the youth 意为“青年人（这个群体）”，那时什么都要怪到年轻人头上，如今也一样。
youth 意为“年轻、朝气”，她六十一岁时身上仍有那股朝气，我父亲指的是她还笑得出来。
the youth of the village 意为“村里的青年们”，1940 年村里剩下的十一二个青年都走了，其中三个没能回来。
youth club 意为“青年俱乐部”，1961 年她每周五在青年俱乐部帮忙：十一个孩子，一架钢琴。
a youth of seventeen 意为“一个十七岁的年轻人”，她说那儿有个十七岁的年轻人让她想起一个她不肯说出名字的人。
the youth 意为“（她那一段）青春、青年时期”，她那段青春一共十一年，是她从未讲过的部分。
the youth 意为“青春”，我的那段青春一直持续到三十一岁，她说我把青春全花在了没有用的地方。
